title: Lost Communication With ECM/PCM
description: Other control modules on the CAN bus network have lost communication with the Engine Control Module (ECM) or Powertrain Control Module (PCM).
possibleCauses: Blown ECM/PCM power fuse
Poor ground connection to the ECM
Open or shorted CAN bus wiring
Failed ECM/PCM
solutions: Check all ECM/PCM fuses and relays
Inspect and clean ECM ground connections
Test CAN bus network for continuity and shorts
Replace the ECM/PCM

title: Lost Communication With TCM
description: Other control modules have lost communication with the Transmission Control Module (TCM).
possibleCauses: Blown TCM power fuse
Damaged wiring harness leading to the transmission
Poor ground connection to the TCM
Failed TCM
solutions: Check TCM fuses and power supply
Inspect wiring harness near the transmission for damage
Clean TCM ground connections
Replace the TCM

title: Lost Communication With ABS Module
description: Other control modules on the network have lost communication with the Anti-lock Brake System (ABS) module.
possibleCauses: Blown ABS module fuse
Corroded ABS module connector
Poor ground to the ABS module
Failed ABS control module
solutions: Inspect all ABS fuses
Disconnect and clean the ABS module connector
Check and tighten ABS grounds
Replace the ABS module

title: Lost Communication With Body Control Module
description: Other control modules on the network have lost communication with the Body Control Module (BCM).
possibleCauses: Blown BCM fuse
Open or short in the CAN bus communication lines
Poor ground connection to the BCM
Failed Body Control Module
solutions: Check all BCM related fuses
Test CAN bus wiring for continuity
Check BCM power and ground circuits
Replace or program the BCM

title: Invalid Data Received From ECM/PCM
description: A module on the network received a data packet from the ECM/PCM that was implausible or invalid.
possibleCauses: Software glitch in the ECM or receiving module
Faulty engine sensor sending bad data to the ECM
Intermittent CAN bus wiring issue
Low battery voltage
solutions: Check for and resolve any engine sensor P-codes first
Update software/firmware on the ECM
Check battery voltage and charging system
Clear codes and road test

title: Invalid Data Received From ABS Module
description: A module on the network received a data packet from the ABS module that was implausible or invalid.
possibleCauses: Faulty wheel speed sensor providing erratic data
Differing tire sizes causing erratic ABS calculations
Software glitch in the ABS module
Corroded wiring at the ABS connector
solutions: Diagnose and fix any wheel speed sensor C-codes first
Ensure all tires are the correct and identical size
Check and clean ABS module connections
Update ABS module software
